title: Bar Drop Frozen Peach 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Frozen Peach by Drop is a simple yet effective fruit blend that highlights the delicate flavour of peach. It delivers the soft, nectar-sweet taste of ripe peaches on the inhale, full of juicy character. A blast of ice on the exhale transforms the profile into a frosty, refreshing treat, like a frozen fruit sorbet. Mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid provides exceptional flavour definition, ensuring the subtle floral notes of the peach aren't lost to the cooling element. Perfect for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth draw in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
